text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Royce~ You got the party 
invitation, right?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've received them. Turbo-san, 
Tannhauser-san, Ikuno-san, Earth-san... 
fufu, the usual crowd, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well~ everyone's full of energy. Turbo 
randomly said she's making a banner, and 
Tannhauser and Earth are making a huge 
fuss too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san is actually quite a good sport 
about these things, after all. It's going 
to be a lively gathering.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, just enjoy yourself. We've got 
plenty of things planned, so—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek♡ What a shocker! Surprise and more 
surprise~☆

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? Practicing my reactions.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With this lineup of members, they're 
definitely plotting a surprise, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Reactions are the foundation of character 
building. You have to give an even more 
memorable response!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~, if it's a present, just say so! 
Relief, sweet relief~♡

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. Looks like I'm the only sane 
person here... Man, this really is gonna 
be one rowdy party~."
